parameters.name: dataSourceName
parameters.description: The name of the data source.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: The data center where the data source is deployed.

parameters.name: validStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies the index versions to be returned. Valid values:

1.  true (default): returns the index versions that are complete and not expired.
2.  false: returns all index versions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun searchengine list-date-source-generations --instance-id ha-cn-pl32rf00000 --data-source-name ha-cn-pl32rf00000_test_api --valid-status true --domain-name bj_vpc_domain_1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun searchengine GET /openapi/ha3/instances/ha-cn-pl32rf00000/data-sources/ha-cn-pl32rf00000_test_api/generations --region cn-hangzhou --validStatus true --domainName bj_vpc_domain_1 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
